item.title: The Barbarian Bible
item.description: About the Author In the Empire, the emphasis is on equality. Liars rule the world, for the most part. Liars are more dangerous than bandits, they live among us, while bandits generally not. Liars are usually camouflaged as “Experts”. If I want to take your money, the easiest and safest way is to convince you that I’m better at handling money than you. How? By convincing you that economics is difficult.
